text:
Samir: hi team, I'm Samir (backend eng), first week. Need help getting Vault + KMS for a feature branch. Do I open a ticket or DM someone?

devex-bot: Welcome Samir! See onboarding steps: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/secrets

Priority quick path: 1) For dev/demo access, request a temporary Vault token via the devex channel or file a 'vault-access' issue with team and paths. 2) For KMS test keys, mention usage and environment in the eng-security thread. Manager or team lead approve required for prod.

Samir: Can you be specific on what to put in the 'vault-access' issue?

Priya: Hey Samir, include: team name, repo, list of secret prefixes (e.g., secret/data/product-search/*), whether you need read or write, and justification + test timeframe. Example title: "vault-access: product-search - read demo creds". Attach manager approval screenshot or @mention.

Samir: Cool. Does new hire token get group membership or do I need to be added separately?

Luca: Newhire tokens are scoped and expire. We also make a group invite after you hit day 2. For now Alex (devex) can create a token with policy 'newhire' giving read to the dev paths.

Samir: @Tia can you approve the dev path?

Tia: Approved. I'll ping eng-security if we need longer KMS perms.

Priya: Rotation basics: we follow the internal rotation playbook: daily audits, rotate service keys every 90 days, rotate highly-sensitive keys every 30 days. For ad-hoc rotation, create a 'key-rotation' job in the infra repo and link the PR to the rotation ticket.

Samir: Thanks all. Will open the issue now and DM Alex for a 24h token.
